effect_description_eng: [When Moving] [On Play] By trashing 1 card in your hand, you may return 1 card with the [Onmyōjutsu] or [Plug-In] trait from your trash to your hand.
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent that deletion.)
